description: Tasks for the LedgerLens API security and workspace isolation implementation.

tasks.description: Capture the current backend behavior needed to verify the scoped security changes.
tasks.requirements: Record the existing backend API behavior relevant to workspace handling, uploads, errors, and scheduled data operations before implementation. Keep the baseline limited to behavior affected by this requested work.

tasks.description: Harden the API and isolate all persisted data by workspace.
tasks.requirements: Enforce a required, valid workspace context on applicable API requests and scope every database query and relevant schema migration/index/constraint to that workspace. Add DELETE /api/v1/workspace and configurable scheduled cleanup with a 24-hour default retention. Add IP- and workspace-based general and upload rate limits, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After, and handle proxy headers using an explicit trusted-proxy configuration. Load CORS origins from ALLOWED_ORIGINS and reject wildcard origins in production. Add security headers. Ensure ApiExceptionHandler returns Portuguese ProblemDetail responses without exposing internal exception details; log unexpected details only on the server. Prevent logs from containing request contents, descriptive text, or values. Restrict actuator exposure to health. Add application-prod.yml configuration for datasource, allowed origins, and PORT. Follow existing repository patterns, integrate changes with PostgreSQL/Flyway, and do not modify .copilot-instructions.md or unrelated code.

tasks.description: Build and run integration tests for workspace isolation and API security behavior.
tasks.requirements: Add and run integration tests for absent and invalid workspace headers, tenant isolation across workspaces, general and upload rate limits (including HTTP 429 and Retry-After), incorrect upload content type, and scheduled cleanup using configurable retention. Verify the persistence schema/migrations support workspace scoping and that the tests use the repository's existing database integration-test patterns.
